captureMethod.authentication: manual Microsoft sign-in completed by operator in the Playwright browser
captureMethod.tokenHandling: tokens were not exported or written to disk; portal response bodies were captured through Playwright response listeners and sanitized

apps.query: editable classic canvas apps in target environment
apps.blockerImpact: The documented original and optimized MCHS canvas app IDs are visible in the target environment, but this sweep did not execute connector-backed app screens or capture request/response smoke output.

connections.blockerImpact: The target environment exposes connected generic connections, including Office, Dataverse, Teams, Planner, Users, and SharePoint connections, but no mchs_service_boundary or mchs-service-boundary connection was observed in the captured inventory.

customConnectors.blockerImpact: The custom connector catalog loaded for the target environment, but the captured inventory did not expose an MCHS service-boundary custom connector match.

flows.blockerImpact: The target Power Automate My flows page rendered and reported zero flows, so no MCHS flow run metadata was available for flow smoke evidence.

remainingActions: Open the visible MCHS app and execute connector-backed screens against a real service-boundary connection, then capture request/response smoke evidence.
Create or bind the mchs-service-boundary custom connector connection and record the real connection ID.
Ensure the expected MCHS Power Automate flows are imported or shared into the target environment, then capture flowId, runId, runStatus, and runUrl for each smoke run.
Capture tenant DLP and monitoring policy evidence from the appropriate admin portal.
